text: Skechers U.S.A., Inc. (formerly NYSE: SKX) was acquired by the private investment firm 3G Capital; the acquisition completed on 12 September 2025 and Skechers' shares stopped trading on the NYSE.
short: Skechers is owned by 3G Capital (acquisition completed September 2025).

source.name: Skechers (about.skechers.com) press release: 3G Capital Completes Acquisition of Skechers
source.quote: Skechers U.S.A., Inc., a Fortune 500 company and the third largest footwear company in the world, and 3G Capital today announced that 3G Capital has completed its acquisition of Skechers.
